description: Get disgusted with misery and immaturity it distorts your vision. #selflove #selfimprovement #selfcare
transcript: Change happens when you become disgusted with bad behavior. Two things that I stay clear of is misery and immaturity. I was on a phone call and I was listening and observing the way that the person on the other line was speaking. And the conversation began to make me feel internally ill. Listen to your body, it will always notify you when you are in a space you no longer need to be in. Get disgusted by bad behavior.
